current_bankroll_policy.track_side_split_note: Owner decision 2026-10-26: O/U 2.5 is staked and reviewed per SIDE. The tracks new_format|OU25 and standard|OU25 were replaced by new_format|OU25_OVER, new_format|OU25_UNDER, standard|OU25_OVER and standard|OU25_UNDER, each starting with EXACTLY its parent's settings (state, base_fraction, odds caps, evidence_score, track_tier_multipliers), so every stake on the day of the split is identical. Key = src/bankroll_policy.track_key(model_type, market, side); an O/U 2.5 tip with no valid side gets no stake. From the 2026-11-01 review Pro evaluates each side as its own track under the unchanged rules (reductions-only until the allocator is walk-forward validated). Evidence at the split (settled live from 2026-08-10, flat 1u): NF OVER n147 ROI +4.0% [-15.6,+25.1]; NF UNDER n402 -0.4% [-13.5,+11.9]; STD OVER n197 -12.4%; STD UNDER n197 -14.8% - not significant, so no stake change.
